name: Cameco Corporation
content: Cameco Corporation is one of the world’s largest global providers of the uranium fuel needed to energize a clean-air world. Based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, the company maintains a significant presence in the nuclear fuel cycle, including uranium mining, milling, refining, conversion, and fuel manufacturing. Cameco operates high-grade mines in Canada and Kazakhstan and provides fuel services to nuclear power plants worldwide. Through its ownership in Westinghouse Electric Company, it also provides nuclear plant technologies, products, and services, supporting the global transition to carbon-free energy.

Officers

Tim GitzelJuly 2011

President and Chief Executive Officer

Tim Gitzel is President and Chief Executive Officer of Cameco. He has more than 30 years of experience in the Canadian and international uranium mining industry. He joined Cameco in 2007 as Senior Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer and was appointed President in 2010 and CEO in 2011. Prior to joining Cameco, he was Executive Vice-President, mining business unit for AREVA in Paris, France.

Grant IsaacJuly 2011

Executive Vice-President and Chief Financial Officer

Grant Isaac is Executive Vice-President and Chief Financial Officer. He joined Cameco in 2009 and has held various executive roles including Senior Vice-President, Corporate Strategy and Vice-President, Corporate Strategy and Business Development. Before joining Cameco, he was the Dean of the Edwards School of Business at the University of Saskatchewan.

Brian ReillyJuly 2017

Senior Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer

Brian Reilly is Senior Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer. He joined Cameco in 2011 as President of Cameco Resources and was appointed to his current role in 2017. He has over 35 years of experience in the mining industry, including roles with AREVA.

Alice WongJuly 2011

Senior Vice-President and Chief Corporate Officer

Alice Wong is Senior Vice-President and Chief Corporate Officer. She has been with Cameco for over 30 years, holding various leadership positions in marketing, corporate responsibility, and human resources.

Sean QuinnApril 2014

Senior Vice-President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary

Sean Quinn is Senior Vice-President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary. He joined Cameco in 1993 and has held various legal roles within the company.
